key_insight: CMDO improves population-based optimization by storing and recalling search experiences as context–behavior–outcome memories, rather than reusing only prior solutions.
engineering_relevance: This can make black-box parameter fitting more adaptive and reliable for engineering design tasks such as photovoltaic model estimation.
method: Uses working, episodic, and consolidated memory to organize search experience.
Retrieves memories by similarity to the current search state and uses both positive and negative evidence.
Reconstructs search from the current population via exploratory, directed, and local behaviors with adaptive geometry.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports benchmarking on BBOB/COCO and CEC2017, plus seven-parameter photovoltaic model fitting, with problem-dependent but competitive results and the lowest median error on CEC2017 F10.
watch_item: Performance is problem-dependent, so gains may not generalize across all objective landscapes or require careful tuning of memory and search settings.
paper_title: CMDO: A Cognitive Memory-Driven Optimization Algorithm for Adaptive Population-Based Search
